observations: Desktop footer separates current playback/Stop and the seek/pause strip from author Check/Apply actions.
Chinese/English/Japanese 390px layout exposes the seek slider, time, Continue and Stop; long identifiers wrap and author content remains independently scrollable.

scope: Actual Chrome screenshots and focus assertions, not native device acceptance.
